description:
Xingqiu ( Chinese : 行秋 Xíngqiū ) is a playable Hydro character in Genshin Impact .

He is the second son of the Guild Manager of the Feiyun Commerce Guild , an influential group in Liyue , and is also a self-proclaimed practitioner of the Guhua Clan 's arts. Also an avid reader, Xingqiu aims to be the embodiment of chivalry like the heroes from the books he reads; however, this belies his knack for mischief.
role_summary: Xingqiu ( Chinese : 行秋 Xíngqiū ) is a playable Hydro character in Genshin Impact .

talents.name: Guhua Style
talents.description: Normal Attack Performs up to 5 rapid strikes. Charged Attack Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes. Plunging Attack Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

talents.name: Guhua Sword: Fatal Rainscreen
talents.description: Xingqiu performs twin strikes with his sword, dealing Hydro DMG . At the same time, this ability creates the maximum number of Rain Swords, which will orbit your active character. The Rain Swords have the following properties: When a character takes DMG, the Rain Sword will shatter, reducing the amount of DMG taken . Increases the character's resistance to interruption . 20% of Xingqiu's Hydro DMG Bonus will be converted to additional DMG Reduction for the Rain Swords. The maximum amount of additional DMG Reduction that can be gained this way is 24%. The initial maximum number of Rain Swords is 3. Using this ability applies the Wet status onto the character.

talents.name: Guhua Sword: Raincutter
talents.description: Initiate Rainbow Bladework and fight using an illusory sword rain, while creating the maximum number of Rain Swords . Rainbow Bladework Your active character's Normal Attacks will trigger consecutive sword rain attacks, dealing Hydro DMG . Rain Swords will remain at the maximum number throughout the ability's duration.

talents.name: Hydropathic
talents.description: When a Rain Sword is shattered or when its duration expires, it regenerates the current character's HP based on 6% of Xingqiu's Max HP.

talents.name: Blades Amidst Raindrops
talents.description: Xingqiu gains a 20% Hydro DMG Bonus .

talents.name: Flash of Genius
talents.description: When Xingqiu crafts Character Talent Materials , he has a 25% chance to refund a portion of the crafting materials used.

c1.name: The Scent Remained
c1.effect: Description Preview Increases the maximum number of Rain Swords by 1. Hover over previews to view in higher quality. ( Preview Preferences ) Media:Constellation The Scent Remained.mp4

c2.name: Rainbow Upon the Azure Sky
c2.effect: Extends the duration of Guhua Sword: Raincutter by 3s. Decreases the Hydro RES of opponents hit by sword rain attacks by 15% for 4s.

c3.name: Weaver of Verses
c3.effect: Increases the Level of Guhua Sword: Raincutter by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Evilsoother
c4.effect: Description Gameplay Notes Throughout the duration of Guhua Sword: Raincutter , the DMG dealt by Guhua Sword: Fatal Rainscreen is increased by 50%. The DMG increase of this constellation is not a DMG Bonus . Instead, it provides a Base DMG Multiplier of 1.5 which is directly multiplicative with the Elemental Skill's Base DMG.

c5.name: Embrace of Rain
c5.effect: Increases the Level of Guhua Sword: Fatal Rainscreen by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Hence, Call Them My Own Verses
c6.effect: Description Gameplay Notes Preview Activating 2 of Guhua Sword: Raincutter 's sword rain attacks greatly enhances the third sword rain attack. On hit, the third sword rain attack also regenerates 3 Energy for Xingqiu. Before unlocking this constellation, during the duration of Guhua Sword: Raincutter , the number of swords per attack consistently alternates between 2 swords and 3 swords. After unlocking this constellation, the order is 2 Swords → 3 Swords → 5 Swords. Hover over previews to view in higher quality. ( Preview Preferences ) Media:Hence, Call Them My Own Verses Preview.mp4
